title: Moscow Parking Occupancy: 4.6M half-hourly snapshots
subtitle: 210 municipal parking lots, 30-minute granularity, continuous since March 2025

resources.description: Static metadata for 210 municipal parking lots: name, address, nearest metro, WGS-84 coordinates, total/common/accessible capacity as declared today, plus last_free_at and feed_silent marking lots whose occupancy the city does not publish.

Occupancy snapshots every 30 minutes: time (UTC), parking_id, free_spaces (common pool only), free_handicapped_spaces, occupancy_rate (percent of common spaces occupied, normally 0-100 but negative in 0.42% of rows - see README).

_comment: Справочный файл: публикация идёт через publish/kaggle_upload.py, который этот json не читает. Описания файлов и колонок Kaggle принимает только из веб-интерфейса — через API поле data возвращает 201 и молча отбрасывается.
